primary_confirmatory.name: security_state_new_total
primary_confirmatory.description: Number of testcases that triggered new security_state coverage transitions

secondary_exploratory.name: security_state_total
secondary_exploratory.description: Total security_state coverage observed (cumulative, not new)
secondary_exploratory.note: Confounds initial corpus with new discoveries; reported descriptively

secondary_exploratory.name: body_score_pass
secondary_exploratory.description: Number of testcases that passed the scoring threshold
secondary_exploratory.phase3_observed_behavior: AE accepted all (25/25 per run), SE rejected all (0/25 per run)
secondary_exploratory.note: Describes model-specific filtering behavior, not effectiveness

secondary_exploratory.name: body_score_reject
secondary_exploratory.description: Number of testcases that failed the scoring threshold
secondary_exploratory.note: Inverse of body_score_pass; describes accept/reject patterns

validity_gates.name: body_score_rpc_ok
validity_gates.description: Number of successful RPC calls to the scoring backend
validity_gates.note: Run-level exclusion criterion; not a scientific endpoint

validity_gates.name: body_score_rpc_fail
validity_gates.description: Number of failed RPC calls to the scoring backend
validity_gates.note: Run-level exclusion criterion; not a scientific endpoint

validity_gates.name: trace_invocations
validity_gates.description: Number of times the scorer trace mechanism was invoked
validity_gates.note: Evidence contract requirement; not a scientific endpoint

diagnostic_only.name: counted_execution_count
diagnostic_only.description: Total executions counted by the fuzzer during the run
diagnostic_only.note: Engineering diagnostic; verifies execution budget consumption

diagnostic_only.name: wall_clock_seconds
diagnostic_only.description: Wall-clock time elapsed during the fuzzing run
diagnostic_only.note: Engineering diagnostic; verifies time budget respected

diagnostic_only.name: target_baseline_identity
diagnostic_only.description: Hash or identifier of the target baseline state used
diagnostic_only.note: Reproducibility requirement; not a scientific endpoint

multiplicity_policy.rationale: Single primary confirmatory endpoint; secondary endpoints are exploratory

phase3_observed_coverage_equivalence_not.statement: Both backends discovered identical coverage (security_state_new_total=1) for all paired seeds
phase3_observed_coverage_equivalence_not.interpretation: Descriptive observation from N=5 pilot, not a claim of general equivalence
does_not_imply: No difference will be found in larger study
